'''Two Hares Leaping''' is a [[sword form]]. Other than the name, nothing is known about it. This form was used during the duel between [[Galadedrid Damodred]] and [[Eamon Valda]]. It was used to counter [[Hummingbird Kisses the Honeyrose]].{{ref/book|11|p}}
